references.text: The same theme of returning to the Lord after tribulations in the last days, with a promise of restoration when Israel hears His voice
Repeats the theme of obeying the Lord's voice and turning to Him with all one's heart and all one's soul
The prophecy that the children of Israel will turn back and seek the Lord their God in the last days
In the last days, peoples shall stream to the mountain of the Lord, parallel to the expression 'in the last days'
The call to turn to the Lord with all one's heart in times of trouble
Prophecy about the last days when nations will seek the Lord
Encouragement to return to the Lord after tribulation
Peter's preaching to repent and turn back to God so that sins may be blotted out
Moses predicts that disaster will strike the people in the last days because they do what is evil
Jacob uses the expression 'in the last days' regarding future events for the tribes of Israel
